Наша історія почалася не 2017 року, коли: Our story didn't begin in 2017, when the kennel was officially registered, but much earlier – back in the 1980s. A little girl could stand for hours by a bookshop window, gazing at bright postcards of pedigree dogs. But what captivated her most were the graceful “butterfly dogs” with their wonderful ears and wise, deep eyes. That childhood dream grew through the years until, one day, it came true.
Першим кроком на цьому шляху стала поява: The first step on this path was welcoming our first “butterfly” – a daughter of a superb male imported from Germany. With her arrival, our home was instantly filled with light, elegant charm, energy and unconditional love.

Цуценя переїжджає до вас у віці 3–3,5 мі: Your puppy moves in with you at 3–3.5 months, after completing the vaccination course. Here are a few simple steps to help them settle into their new home quickly and calmly.

Підготуйте цуценяті власне місце – м'яку: Prepare a place of the puppy's own – a soft bed, bowls for water and food and a few toys. Remove cables, small objects and houseplants that could be poisonous.
У день переїзду цуценяті знадобиться зру: On moving day your puppy will need a comfortable carrier or carry bag – it makes the first journey calm and safe, even over a long distance.

Знайдіть перевірену ветеринарну клініку: Find a trusted veterinary clinic near your home before the puppy arrives – you will need it for check-ups, vaccinations and any questions in the first weeks.
Перші тижні годуйте цуценя тим самим кор: For the first weeks, feed your puppy the same food it is used to at the kennel. A sudden change of diet can cause digestive upset – switch to new food gradually.

Цуценята переїжджають у новий дім у віці: Puppies move to their new homes at 3–3.5 months – after completing the full course of vaccinations. Until then, the little one grows up in our home, alongside its mother and the family.
Континентальний той-спанієль, більш відо: The Continental Toy Spaniel, better known as the Papillon, is one of Europe's oldest companion breeds, named after the butterfly for the shape of its ears.
